description: Lunar Exploration, Moon Mission Planning, Space Technology, Scientific Research, Innovation & Sustainability
summary: Back to the Moon is an educational space mission simulation project designed to help users understand the challenges of planning and managing a lunar mission. Through this project, users can explore the journey from Earth to the Moon while learning about spacecraft systems, fuel management, oxygen supply, navigation, and safe lunar landing. Our goal is to make space science more interactive, engaging, and accessible, especially for students and young space enthusiasts. The project highlights the importance of proper planning, teamwork, and resource management in successful Moon exploration.
details:
Our project, Back to the Moon, focuses on making lunar exploration easier to understand through an interactive space mission simulation.

The project allows users to experience the different stages of a Moon mission, starting from Earth launch and continuing through space travel, lunar exploration, and the return journey.

Users can learn about important mission elements such as spacecraft selection, engine systems, fuel consumption, oxygen management, navigation, and safe landing. The simulation emphasizes how proper planning and resource management are essential for a successful space mission.

We aim to make learning about space science more interesting through interactive gameplay, visual elements, and educational challenges.

The project is being developed as a web-based experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Three.js for 3D visualization.

Our team combines project management, programming, game design, user experience, and space science research to develop an engaging educational experience.

Ultimately, Back to the Moon encourages students to explore space science, think critically, solve problems, and understand the challenges of future lunar missions.
